summary: The diff implements all four requirements with complete coverage. REQ-1 (footer) is implemented in Layout.tsx with the exact text. REQ-2 (backend admin system) shows assignUserRole functionality and admin checks in main.mo. REQ-3 (admin UI) is provided via AdminPanel.tsx with Principal-based role assignment. REQ-4 (notification system) is implemented with notification creation on poem submission, polling queries, and mark-as-read functionality. The implementation uses Principal IDs rather than email/username as stated in the requirement, which is a deviation but not a missing feature—it's an implementation choice.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin Panel uses Principal ID for role assignment instead of email or username as specified in requirements
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-2 and REQ-3 explicitly request assignment by email or username, but AdminPanel.tsx only accepts Principal IDs. The form validates Principal.fromText() and there is no email/username lookup mechanism visible in the diff.
